title: Question on the page "connectSearchBox"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[connectSearchBox](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectSearchBox.html)".

How can I just call refine? I don't need any of the other options

comments.body: Do you want to set the query in a life cycle (with rendering of a search box), or do you want to statically set a query? Or an initial query on a page that can be changed with other widgets?
Closing for inactivity – feel free to reopen.
